draftPackage.centralQuestion: How can light reveal an obstacle without being absorbed or reflected by it?
draftPackage.thesis: In an ideal aligned interferometer, an absorbing obstacle changes interference and allows a previously dark detector to click without absorbing that detected photon; other trials can fail.
draftPackage.viewerPayoff: The click reveals a blocked possibility without absorption of the detected photon, while unsuccessful trials retain risk.

segments.text: How can light reveal an obstacle without being absorbed or reflected by it?
Start with one photon and two possible paths that meet again.
In this carefully aligned setup, the waves associated with the paths cancel at one output. This detector stays dark.
Now block one path with an absorber.
Sometimes it absorbs the photon. That trial ends.
But in another trial, the dark detector clicks.
The photon reached this detector. The obstacle was detected, without absorbing that photon.
Why? Blocking one possible path removed the cancellation that kept this detector dark.
This is interaction-free measurement, demonstrated in experiments.
It succeeds only in some trials. Others absorb the photon, or give no clear answer.

misconceptionSafeguards: No two half photons, energy destruction or classical definite trajectory.
Probability-amplitude schematic; no actual measurement footage or trace.
No photon hits absorber then reaches output; separate trial labels.
Correctly aligned ideal apparatus; noise/leakage not erased from review.
Other trials absorb or yield inconclusive output; no guarantee or universal harmless sensing.
No preferred quantum interpretation, consciousness effect, faster-than-light signal or observation-as-mind assertion.
review.comprehensionReview: Owner approves premise, requests causal execution. New exact wording removes front-loaded interferometer jargon; one photon/two possibilities precede cancellation; intervention precedes two separately identified outcomes; successful nonabsorption is climax before explanatory return. Demonstration and probabilistic risks remain explicit. Source statements and qualifications unchanged; original inspected evidence records reused with original retrieval dates, not falsely reread or redated.
review.rightsReview: Original instrument/amplitude artwork only; no research figures, photos or footage. Existing OFL fonts and local Kokoro model; no unresolved rights/purchase.

careAssessment.rationale: Scoped physical explanation and ideal model with author experimental account; no medical use, hazardous demonstration instructions or metaphysical verdict.
